components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Gold action button; the only non-terminal gold in the header.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent, oklch(0.82 0.18 78)); color: var(--accent-text, oklch(0.24 0.015 75)); padding: 0.5rem 1rem; min-height: 44px; border: 1.5px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 2px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); border-color: var(--accent-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--enamel); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--surface, oklch(0.36 0.010 75)); color: var(--text); padding: 0.5rem 1rem; min-height: 44px; border: 1.5px solid var(--border); border-radius: 2px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface-hover); border-color: var(--border-strong); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--enamel); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet action; face appears on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--text-secondary); padding: 0.5rem 1rem; min-height: 44px; border: 1.5px solid transparent; border-radius: 2px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--surface-hover); color: var(--text); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 2px; border: 1.5px solid; } .ds-badge-done { color: var(--state-green); background: var(--state-green-bg); border-color: var(--state-green-border); } .ds-badge-processing { color: var(--state-amber); background: var(--state-amber-bg); border-color: var(--state-amber-border); } .ds-badge-pending { color: var(--text-secondary); background: var(--surface); border-color: var(--border); }

components.name: Card / Manifest Row
components.description: Bench panel container; row anatomy = square art, identity, state.
components.html: The Order of TimeCarlo Rovelli · 4h 19m◆ done
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; background: var(--bg-panel); border: 1.5px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 4px; padding: 16px; text-decoration: none; color: var(--text); } .ds-card:hover { background: var(--surface); } .ds-card__art { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--elevated); flex-shrink: 0; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); } .ds-card__body { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: grid; gap: 2px; } .ds-card__body strong { font-weight: 500; } .ds-card__body em { font-style: normal; font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Face-filled form field with gold focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 2px; font-size: 16px; width: 100%; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--text-muted); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--text); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--focus-ring); } ::placeholder { color: var(--text-placeholder); }

components.name: ADB Provenance Tag
components.description: Magenta chip marking AudiobookDB-sourced data; link when a record exists.
components.css: .ds-abd { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; background: var(--provenance-bg); border: 1px solid var(--provenance-border); border-radius: 2px; color: var(--provenance); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-abd:hover { border-color: var(--provenance); }

components.name: Splice Meter
components.description: Tape-join status light: dashed stubs, halves, chase, seamed bar, snapped break.

narrative.overview: Bragi Books is a tape editor's bench for a personal audiobook pipeline. The operator routes source folders in one side (Intake), confirms catalog metadata (Match), queues the join (Queue), and collects finished reels (Finish). Everything on the surface is bench equipment — a tape-path rail connecting the four stations, a splice meter per book, manifest reels for lists, catalog badges marking community-sourced data. The bench metaphor is the interface's vocabulary for real pipeline state.
keyCharacteristics: Dark warm brown-charcoal surfaces, OKLCH hue 75° axis
Tonal depth by surface mixing; no box-shadows except the modal
Orthogonal geometry: 2–4px radii, square dots, miter joints
Gold = action only; magenta = provenance only; red/amber/green/blue = status only
Monospace for paths, job IDs, tabular data; system sans elsewhere
Every status is shape + text + color; reduced motion collapses animation

rules.name: The Action-Only Gold Rule
rules.body: --accent marks where a hand goes: primary buttons, the active utility link, the brand badge. Never decoration, never status, never a heading color.

rules.name: The Provenance-Magenta Rule
rules.body: --provenance marks data sourced from AudiobookDB and is always paired with a text label. Never applied to status, actions, or empty decoration.

rules.name: The Status-Never-Decorative Rule
rules.body: Red/amber/green signal state; blue signals information. They never color furniture, borders, or text emphasis.

rules.name: The Tonal-Depth Rule
rules.body: Depth is background mixing, never shadow: bg → bg-panel → surface → elevated. The only shadow is the modal overlay.

dos: Do draw depth with surface mixes; bg → bg-panel → surface → elevated (0.24 → 0.30 → 0.36 → 0.40).
Do pair every status color with its shape glyph and word.
Do use monospace for any path, ID, or numeric readout (tabular-nums for tables).
Do keep gold interactive: if it isn't clickable or actively marking you, it isn't gold.
Do keep the whole manifest card as the click target.
Do collapse all animation under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do label absent state honestly: Not generated, Unknown, No processing jobs yet — italic muted, never hidden.
donts: Don't add box-shadows (exception: modal) — depth is tonal.
Don't apply gold to static emphasis, headings, or status.
Don't apply magenta outside provenance contexts.
Don't render raw JSON in operator-facing errors — walk the payload to a sentence, keep the raw under a Technical detail expander.
Don't use serif faces or bookshelf imagery — this is a bench, not a library.
Don't repeat the workflow bays outside the dashboard.
Don't stand unicode in for drawn icons outside the status-glyph vocabulary.
